School Outreach

DSA Code Champs

School Outreach Programme — Grades 3 to 12

DSA's school outreach wing brings AI and coding to Grades 3–12 through four progressive levels — Scratch, Python, machine learning and computer vision — in schools across Chennai and online.

4 Weeks (1 session per week) · Weekend Bootcamps available Online · Offline in Chennai DSA Code Champs Participation Certificate
Bring DSA Code Champs to Your School → Programme details

Overview

DSA Code Champs is a school outreach initiative designed to nurture early interest in STEM and AI among school students from Grade 3 to Grade 12. Through fun, activity-based, and project-driven learning across four progressive levels — from Scratch and introductory Python to machine learning and computer vision — we plant the seeds for tomorrow's AI engineers, researchers, and innovators. Every session is designed to be engaging, visual, and hands-on, making technology accessible and exciting for young minds.

Code Champs is delivered through fully managed school visits across Chennai and nearby areas, or as online interactive live sessions, with all materials, activity sheets and kits provided by DSA. The programme now runs as four progressive levels — Code Explorers, Builders, Innovators and Pioneers — for Grades 3 to 12, covering Scratch, Python, machine learning and computer vision, aligned with NEP 2020 and with a special focus on girls in STEM.

What you'll gain

6 outcomes
  • First steps in programming using Scratch (visual) and Python (text)
  • Core computational thinking and mathematical logic skills
  • Introduction to Artificial Intelligence concepts in simple terms
  • Awareness of Robotics and IoT through demonstrations and activities
  • Confidence to explore coding beyond the school curriculum
  • DSA Code Champs participation certificate for portfolio

What Students Explore

🐱

Scratch Programming

Visual drag-and-drop coding to build games, stories, and animations

🐍

Introductory Python

Simple programs, turtle graphics, and mini-games — first real code

🧩

Computational Thinking

Problem decomposition, pattern recognition, and algorithm design

🔢

Mathematical Logic

Number puzzles, logic challenges, and the maths behind programming

🤖

Introduction to AI

What is AI, how it learns, and how it affects everyday life

⚡

Robotics & IoT

Live demonstrations and hands-on kits exploring real-world automation

What Students Learn

  • Basics of Programming — variables, loops, conditions using Scratch
  • Introductory Python — simple programs, turtle graphics, mini-games
  • Computational Thinking — problem decomposition, pattern recognition
  • Mathematical Logic — puzzles, number patterns, algorithm thinking
  • Introduction to Artificial Intelligence — what is AI and how it works
  • Robotics & IoT — live demos and hands-on kits (where available)

Session Format

  • Weekly 90-minute interactive sessions (or weekend bootcamp format)
  • Activity-first approach — students do before they are taught theory
  • Team challenges and mini-hackathons to build collaboration skills
  • Show-and-tell: students present their mini-projects each session
  • Q&A time with DSA faculty — demystifying AI and technology
  • Fun quizzes and leaderboard — gamified learning experience

School Partnership

  • DSA visits your school or college campus (Chennai and nearby)
  • Fully managed programme — no teacher preparation required
  • Custom scheduling to fit the school calendar and timetable
  • All materials, activity sheets, and kits provided by DSA
  • Post-programme student performance report for the school
  • Parents invited to a closing showcase of student projects

Our STEM Mission

  • Goal: make every child in India curious about technology
  • Aligned with NEP 2020 computational thinking competencies
  • Special focus on encouraging girls in STEM and AI
  • Bridges the gap between school curriculum and future careers
  • Inspiring the next generation of Data Scientists and AI researchers
  • Supported by DSA's team of PhD-qualified faculty and AI engineers

School Partnership Process

  1. 1

    Partner with DSA

    School coordinator reaches out; DSA schedules a planning meeting

  2. 2

    Schedule Sessions

    4-week calendar built around school timetable and academic calendar

  3. 3

    DSA Visits

    Trainers arrive with all materials, kits, and activity sheets — no prep needed

  4. 4

    Interactive Sessions

    90-minute fun, project-based sessions each week with team challenges

  5. 5

    Closing Showcase

    Students present projects to parents and teachers; certificates awarded

Eligibility & prerequisites

📋

No prior technology experience needed. Designed for complete beginners aged 11–15. All a student needs is curiosity and enthusiasm.
